name: Micaiah
overview: Micaiah is a male biblical figure identified as the son of Gemariah, as recorded in Jeremiah 36:10-11. There is no tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him in Scripture. His identity is primarily grounded in his paternal connection.
namesAndTitles: The name Micaiah means 'Who is like YHWH?' This proper name reflects a rhetorical question emphasizing the uniqueness and supremacy of the Lord, though it was not given by God directly according to the record in Jeremiah 36:10.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Micaiah as the son of Gemariah in Jeremiah 36:11. No other family relationships are documented beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Micaiah's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his identification as the son of Gemariah during the events described in Jeremiah 36. While the record is brief, his mention situates him within the prophetic context of Jeremiah's ministry and the transmission of God's word during a critical period in Judah's history.
